oth-achievements-en.name: Under the Stars
oth-achievements-en.description: Set up a campsite for the first time.

oth-achievements-en.name: New Horizons
oth-achievements-en.description: Find the exit from an area.

oth-achievements-en.name: Close Encounter
oth-achievements-en.description: Photograph a mammal from less than 10 meters away.

oth-achievements-en.name: All Dressed Up
oth-achievements-en.description: Equip at least 5 cosmetics at the same time.

oth-achievements-en.name: Back to the Cabin
oth-achievements-en.description: Fast travel to an unlocked cabin.

oth-achievements-en.name: Held by a Thread
oth-achievements-en.description: Hang suspended by your winch for 10 seconds, while completely in the air.

oth-achievements-en.name: Close Call
oth-achievements-en.description: Pull your fully submerged vehicle out of the water using the winch.

oth-achievements-en.name: A Gift from the Stars
oth-achievements-en.description: Collect a meteorite within 5 minutes of its impact.

oth-achievements-en.name: Under the Water
oth-achievements-en.description: Completely fill the water resistance bar so that the vehicle shuts down.

oth-achievements-en.name: Odysseus
oth-achievements-en.description: Drive for 1 hour without going near a cabin.

oth-achievements-en.name: Soundtrack to the Journey
oth-achievements-en.description: Drive 10 km without stopping the music.

oth-achievements-en.name: Taking Flight
oth-achievements-en.description: Make a jump with your vehicle.

oth-achievements-en.name: Smooth Ride
oth-achievements-en.description: Complete a trail without taking any damage.

oth-achievements-en.name: Law of the Land
oth-achievements-en.description: Equip a blue livery and the 'Red & Blue Beacons' or 'Red & Blue Beacon Bar' at the same time.

oth-achievements-en.name: Sound of Nature
oth-achievements-en.description: Drive 10 km without listening to music.
